Class Ritual

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.event.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.event.Ritual
public class Ritual extends Event
An event card that rewards the player with the most stars and penalises the player with the fewest.

When resolved during GamePhaseEnum.END_ROUND or GamePhaseEnum.PLAY_EVENT, the player(s) with the highest star count gain ppGain prestige points (doubled if the double shaman bonus is active), and the player(s) with the lowest star count lose ppLoss prestige points (unless protected by PP loss protection).

      Constructs a Ritual event from its JSON properties.
      Parameters:
      id - unique card identifier
      trigger - the game phase during which this event is resolved
      interactiveEffects - interactive effects carried by this card
      instantEffects - instant effects carried by this card
      age - the age this card belongs to (1–3)
      ppLoss - PP deducted from the player(s) with the fewest stars
      ppGain - base PP awarded to the player(s) with the most stars
      type - the card type (always CardTypeEnum.RITUAL)

  • Method Details

    • execEvent

      public void execEvent(List<Player> players, GamePhaseEnum phase)
      Resolves the ritual for all players.

      The player(s) with the highest star count receive the PP gain (via Player.applyRitualGain(int), which doubles the amount if the double shaman bonus is active). The player(s) with the lowest star count suffer the PP loss (via Player.applyRitualLoss(int), which is a no-op if PP protection is active). The event only fires during GamePhaseEnum.END_ROUND or GamePhaseEnum.PLAY_EVENT.

      Specified by:
      execEvent in class Event
      Parameters:
      players - the list of all players; must not be null
      phase - the current game phase
